question.text: Per the workbook's effective-rate table for LTCG on listed STT-paid equity shares held by a Cat III AIF trust in the hands of individuals/HUF/AOP/BOI (post-surcharge-cap and cess), the effective rate is:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook's effective-rate table reports 14.95% for individuals, HUF, AOP, and BOI investors on LTCG from listed STT-paid equity shares held by a Category III AIF. The 12.5% statutory base rate under Section 112A is grossed up by the applicable surcharge and 4% health and education cess to reach the 14.95% effective figure shown in the table. The Trap: 14.56% is the effective rate the workbook lists for 'other' and corporate-resident investors. 13.65% is the foreign-corporate effective LTCG rate. 12.5% is the pre-surcharge statutory rate before cess. Note: The INR 1.25 lakh exemption under Section 112A is available before applying the 12.5% base rate, but the effective-rate table itself is post-surcharge and cess and assumes the exemption has been considered separately.
